turns.text: Of course, you're not ordering them.
turns.zh: 当然，你又不是在命令他们。

turns.text: Speaking of favors, um Liam, can I ask you a favor?
turns.zh: 说到帮忙，嗯，利亚姆，我能请你帮个忙吗？

turns.text: Well, you know, I really, really like this new car.
turns.zh: 嗯，你知道吧，我特别特别特别喜欢这辆新车。

turns.text: Um, can you buy me that car?
turns.zh: 嗯，你能给我买那辆车吗？
